The objective function is:

def compute_obj(theta, n):
    x_arr = np.linspace(0, 2, n)
    h_vals = h_net(theta, x_arr)
    corr = np.correlate(h_vals, 1-h_vals, mode='full')
    return np.max(corr) * (2/n)
